about:
Poly-Ject Inc. was founded in 1982 in Amherst, New Hampshire. The company began as a custom plastic injection molding operation and has grown into a full-service provider of design, rapid prototyping, mold making, and injection molding.

Operating from a 26,000-square-foot facility in Amherst, Poly-Ject runs injection molding production 24 hours a day, five days a week. The company maintains in-house mold-making and engineering design capabilities, allowing it to handle projects from concept through production. Services include plastic injection molding, custom molding, rapid prototyping, and mold making.

Poly-Ject serves customers across New England and the broader United States, providing plastic components for a range of applications. The company does not disclose specific industry verticals or named clients in its public materials.

The company emphasizes domestic production as an alternative to offshore sourcing, citing quality and price competitiveness. Its ISO 9000 certification and policy of not shipping parts that fail quality checks underscore a focus on consistency.
